description.value:
You deploy a high-adhesive incendiary charge that clings to the first surface it contacts and burns steadily, denying the area.

Choose a point within 30 feet. All creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:5]{5-foot burst} centered on that point must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|options:me-power:me-npc-sticky-grenade] save against the creature's power DC.

Critical Success Unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[(2*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[fire]] damage.

Failure The target takes @Damage[(4*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[fire]] damage and gains Persistent 1d6 fire damage (DC 12 flat check to end).

Critical Failure The target takes @Damage[(6*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[fire]] damage and gains Persistent 2d6 fire damage (DC 15 flat check to end).

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
